narrative.intro: Csi Aviation reported $278M in federal contract obligations for FY2027 to date. Csi Aviation received 1 award this fiscal year, giving an average award size of $278M. Csi Aviation obligations rose and fell sharply across recent fiscal years: $4.8M in FY22, $162M in FY23, $350M in FY24, $661M in FY25, $1.3B in FY26, and $278M in FY27.
